_comment: Phase-4 golden-test fixture: a small 10-class CNN (Conv2d -> auto Requant+ReLU -> avg Pool -> Linear). The model is the serialized IR graph under 'graph' (the Rust runtime deserializes and walks it). The 10 logits are the graph output; the client argmaxes them. FHE output must equal these quantized-cleartext logits/labels bit-for-bit. Synthetic dataset stand-in (see cnn_export.py).
